parameters.name: ImageDataA
parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded string of image A. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding, see [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).
> Specify either **ImageURLA** or **ImageDataA**. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence.

parameters.name: ImageDataB
parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded string of image B. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding, see [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).
> Specify either **ImageURLB** or **ImageDataB**. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence.

parameters.name: ImageURLA
parameters.description:
The URL of image A. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> Specify either **ImageURLA** or **ImageDataA**. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence.

parameters.name: ImageURLB
parameters.description:
The URL of image B. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
> Specify either **ImageURLB** or **ImageDataB**. If both URL and Base64 encoding are specified, the URL takes precedence.

parameters.name: QualityScoreThreshold
parameters.description: The quality score threshold. Performs quality analysis on face images. If the quality score of a face is less than this threshold, a MessageTips field is added to the response.
